package handlers

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"archive/zip"
	"bytes"
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/http"
	pathpkg "path"
	"strings"
)

type starterUploadFile struct {
	name string
	path string
	data []byte
}

func collectStarterUploadFiles(request *http.Request) ([]starterUploadFile, error) {
	if err := request.ParseMultipartForm(128 << 20); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse multipart form: %w", err)
	}
	if request.MultipartForm == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("multipart form is empty")
	}

	fileHeaders := request.MultipartForm.File["files"]
	if len(fileHeaders) == 0 {
		fileHeaders = request.MultipartForm.File["file"]
	}
	if len(fileHeaders) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("at least one file is required")
	}

	rawPaths := request.MultipartForm.Value["paths"]
	items := make([]starterUploadFile, 0, len(fileHeaders))
	for index, header := range fileHeaders {
		pathValue := header.Filename
		if len(rawPaths) == len(fileHeaders) && strings.TrimSpace(rawPaths[index]) != "" {
			pathValue = rawPaths[index]
		}
		safePath, err := sanitizeStarterPath(pathValue, header.Filename)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		content, err := readMultipartFile(header)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		items = append(items, starterUploadFile{
			name: header.Filename,
			path: safePath,
			data: content,
		})
	}
	return items, nil
}

func readMultipartFile(header *multipart.FileHeader) ([]byte, error) {
	file, err := header.Open()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open uploaded file %q: %w", header.Filename, err)
	}
	defer func() {
		_ = file.Close()
	}()
	content, err := io.ReadAll(file)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("read uploaded file %q: %w", header.Filename, err)
	}
	return content, nil
}

func sanitizeStarterPath(raw string, fallback string) (string, error) {
	value := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
	if value == "" {
		value = fallback
	}
	value = strings.ReplaceAll(value, "\\", "/")
	value = strings.TrimPrefix(value, "/")
	value = pathpkg.Clean(value)
	if value == "." || value == "" {
		value = fallback
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(value, "../") || value == ".." {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("invalid starter path %q", raw)
	}
	return value, nil
}

func buildStarterArchive(files []starterUploadFile) ([]byte, string, error) {
	if len(files) == 1 {
		switch detectStarterArchiveFormat(files[0].name) {
		case "zip":
			return files[0].data, archiveFilename(files[0].name), nil
		case "tar":
			archiveData, err := tarArchiveToZip(files[0].data, false)
			return archiveData, archiveFilename(files[0].name), err
		case "tar.gz":
			archiveData, err := tarArchiveToZip(files[0].data, true)
			return archiveData, archiveFilename(files[0].name), err
		}
	}
	archiveData, err := packFilesToZip(files)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return archiveData, "starter-files.zip", nil
}

func detectStarterArchiveFormat(filename string) string {
	lower := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(filename))
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".zip"):
		return "zip"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"), strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		return "tar.gz"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar"):
		return "tar"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func archiveFilename(filename string) string {
	base := strings.TrimSpace(filename)
	if base == "" {
		return "starter-files.zip"
	}
	lower := strings.ToLower(base)
	switch {
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar.gz"):
		return strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".tar.gz") + ".zip"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tgz"):
		return strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".tgz") + ".zip"
	case strings.HasSuffix(lower, ".tar"):
		return strings.TrimSuffix(base, ".tar") + ".zip"
	default:
		return base
	}
}

func packFilesToZip(files []starterUploadFile) ([]byte, error) {
	var buffer bytes.Buffer
	writer := zip.NewWriter(&buffer)
	for _, file := range files {
		entry, err := writer.Create(file.path)
		if err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("create zip entry %q: %w", file.path, err)
		}
		if _, err := entry.Write(file.data); err != nil {
			_ = writer.Close()
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("write zip entry %q: %w", file.path, err)
		}
	}
	if err := writer.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("close zip archive: %w", err)
	}
	return buffer.Bytes(), nil
}

func tarArchiveToZip(archiveData []byte, gzipped bool) ([]byte, error) {
	reader := bytes.NewReader(archiveData)
	var tarSource io.Reader = reader
	if gzipped {
		gzipReader, err := gzip.NewReader(reader)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("open gzip archive: %w", err)
		}
		defer func() {
			_ = gzipReader.Close()
		}()
		tarSource = gzipReader
	}

	tarReader := tar.NewReader(tarSource)
	files := make([]starterUploadFile, 0)
	for {
		header, err := tarReader.Next()
		if err == io.EOF {
			break
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read tar archive: %w", err)
		}
		if header.FileInfo().IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		safePath, err := sanitizeStarterPath(header.Name, header.Name)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		content, err := io.ReadAll(tarReader)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("read tar entry %q: %w", header.Name, err)
		}
		files = append(files, starterUploadFile{
			name: pathpkg.Base(safePath),
			path: safePath,
			data: content,
		})
	}
	if len(files) == 0 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("archive does not contain files")
	}
	return packFilesToZip(files)
}
